tei:div.tei:p: (117)lus sbyin yum chen zhal lung dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod nyung bsdus bzhugs/ (118)na mo karma ḍāk+ki ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ rang mdun thod pa phyi dkar nang dmar ba/ bkra shis mtshan ldan thod sgyed gsum gyi 'og yaṃ las rlung dkyil ljang gu gzhu brdung dbyibs/ raṃ las me dkyil gru gsum rab 'bar bas/ me rlung 'khrugs pa'i sbyor bas thod pa dres/ nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga/ rang lus rnam pa ngo bo bdud rtsir zhu/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ zag med bdud rtsi dkar dmar mdangs ldan gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ phaṭaḥ 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams nas/ rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin/ phyogs dus sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ nyan thos rang sangs rgyas pa dang*/ rigs lnga rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ khros ma ma cig lab kyi sgron/ gcod yul brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ dkon mchog srid zhu'i mgron rigs rnams/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga/ snang srid mchod pa'i sprin phung gi rnam mang (119)phyi yi tshogs mchod 'bul/ sgegs mjes dgyes pa bskyed pa yi/ rnam mang mchod rdzas thegs pa'i sprin/ dang po rigs ji bzhin yid las sprul/ gzungs rigs nang gi tshogs la rol/ stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*/ chos rnams gdod nas rnam dag pa'i/ lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i tshogs/ dgyes mnyam gsang ba'i tshogs la rol/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma yi/ spyan sngar khas blang dam bcas pa'i/ bka' srung ma mgon lcam dral dang*/ zangs ri btsan rgod 'bar ba dang*/ sham po gza' bdud mgo gu sogs/ mgon po yon tan mgron rigs rnams/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ 'dod pa'i yan tan rnam pa lnga/ snang srid mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ rnam mang phyi yi tshogs mchod phul/ sgegs mjes dgyes pa bskyed pa yi/ rnam mang mchod rdzas thogs pa'i sprin/

dngos rigs ji bzhin yid las sprul/ gzungs rigs nang gi tshogs la rol/ stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*/ chos rnams gdod nas rnam dag pa'i/ lhan skyes bde ba chen (120)po'i tshogs/ dgyes mnyam gsang ba'i tshogs la rol/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ 'og gzhi rlung gi 'khor lo yan/ gnas 'dir rigs drug pha ma yi/ lan chags snying rje'i mgron rigs rnams/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga/ snang srid mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ rnam mang phyi yi tshogs mchod 'bul/ sgegs mjes dgyes pa bskyed pa yi/ rnam mang mchod rdzas thogs pa'i sprin/ dngis rigs ji bzhin yid las sprul/ gzungs rigs nang gi tshogs la rol/ stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*/ chos rnams gdod nas rnam dag pa'i/ lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i tshogs/ dgyes mnyam gsang ba'i tshogs la rol/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi na ya/ 'jig rten las kyis grub pa'i gzugs/ snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre yi/ lan chags bgegs kyi mgron rigs rnams/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga/ (121)(122)snang srid mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ rnam mang phyi yi tshogs mchod 'bul/ sgegs mjes dgyes pa bskyed pa yi/ rnam mang mchod rdzas thogs pa'i sprin/ dngos rigs ji bzhin yid las sprul/ gzungs rigs nang gi tshogs la rol/ stong nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*/ chos rnams gdod nas rnam dag pa'i/ lhan skyes bde ba chen pa'i tshogs/ dgyes mnyam gsang ba'i tshogs la rol/ de ltar mgron rigs ma lus pa/ mchod sbyin tshogs kyi longs spyod bzhes/ sngon gyi lan chags yod pa byang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen gegs ngan pa zhi/ las dang nyon mongs dri ma dag bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shog
ces pa'ang go 'jo lung phu dgon pa'i 'dus sde gcod kyi tshogs grangs bsags pa'i cha rkyen du kaḥthog mkhan ming pas kaḥthog gi gnas 'dab pad lung lcags gling du sbyar ba'o/ dge'o/// /
